name: originwise
description: Local-first China-related product / brand / origin checker

scripts.pages:dev: npm run build && npx --yes wrangler pages dev dist --compatibility-date=2024-09-23
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npx --yes wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name=originwise
scripts.deploy:preview: npm run build && npx --yes wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name=originwise --branch=preview
